name: Being Greedy
overview: Scripture warns that greed brings trouble to one's household and contrasts the pursuit of wealth with the greater value of wisdom and understanding, which are more desirable than gold or silver. God declares ownership over all silver and gold, reminding believers that material wealth belongs to Him alone. Jesus teaches His followers not to be anxious about earthly needs but to invest in eternal treasures through generosity, emphasizing that true security is found in heavenly riches rather than earthly possessions.
